branches.REORIENTED: same packet norm rotated to contemporaneous top right singular vector before each loop

primary_hypotheses.H1_mode_capacity_stays_available: mean sigma1 across generations 2-4 differs from generation 1 by <10% in absolute relative terms; >85% seeds have max relative deviation <20%
primary_hypotheses.H2_inherited_packet_leaves_top_mode: generation-1 alignment >0.90 mean, generation-2 alignment <0.40 mean, and >80% seeds have G2 alignment <0.50
primary_hypotheses.H3_norm_preserving_reorientation_restore: mean REORIENTED actual gain over generations 2-4 >0.85, mean INHERITED gain over generations 2-4 <0.55, and >90% seeds have positive rescue averaged over G2-G4
primary_hypotheses.H4_reorientation_prevents_multigeneratio: G4 REORIENTED norm relative to initial >0.70 mean while G4 INHERITED norm <0.15 mean; >90% seeds have REORIENTED > INHERITED

interpretation_rule.all_pass: with sufficient scalar gain, multigeneration failure is caused primarily by modal drift: the channel retains high-gain capacity, but each inherited packet rotates away from the next generation's amplifiable mode; norm-preserving reorientation prevents extinction
interpretation_rule.H1_fail: carrier capacity itself changes materially, so pure modal-drift interpretation is incomplete
